A box of mass 3.0 kg is pulled a distance 5.0 m directly up a smooth slope by a constant applied force of 30 N acting parallel to the slope.
The initial speed of the box is $3.0 \text{ms}^{-1}$ and the final speed is $7.0 \text{ms}^{-1}$. Its acceleration is constant.
What is the component of the weight acting down the slope?
(gravitational field strength = $10 \text{N kg}^{-1}$; air resistance is negligible)
